text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Hahahaha! To think I'd be backed into a 
corner like this!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
My heart's raisin' hell! It's been a while 
since I felt this kind of rush!
choice_data_list: Let's keep at it at our own pace.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Slow down? Haah? Why the hell would I cool 
this heat off?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
No time to doze off. Come on, let's get 
ready for the next race...!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, at this rate, it's gonna be game 
over soon. Next time, I gotta be ready to 
go all-in.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Heh-heh... This feeling like a fire's been 
lit under my tail... it's getting my blood 
boiling...!
